facts.big: how many · how much · a little · a few
facts.label: Quantidades na padaria
facts.sub: Use how many com coisas que se contam e how much com preço ou coisas que não se contam: How many rolls? How much is a loaf? A little honey, a few cookies.

facts.label: Quantos
facts.sub: Use how many com coisas que se contam, no plural: How many rolls? How many cookies? A resposta pode ser six, a few ou a lot.

facts.label: Quanto
facts.sub: Use how much para o preço e para coisas que não se contam: How much is a loaf? How much honey? A resposta é four dollars ou a little.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: How many is for things we can count.
How much is for things we cannot count.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: How many is for things we can count. → Verdadeiro (Yes: rolls, cookies.)
How much is for things we cannot count. → Verdadeiro (Yes: honey.)
We say “How much rolls?”. → Falso (We say How many rolls?)

pages.title: A small bakery · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a small bakery in Melbourne. Warm bread sits on wooden shelves. Frank puts a tray of rolls on the counter. His friend Nina comes in with a shopping bag. She wants bread for the week. Frank asks what she needs.
“Good morning, Nina! What would you like today?” says Frank. “Good morning, Frank! How many rolls do you have?” says Nina. “I have a lot of rolls. How many would you like?” says Frank.
